topography.project_purpose: Bracket Protocol is a multi-chain DeFi platform offering liquid staking, structured vaults, and escrow staking. It enables users to earn yield through automated strategies, stake assets for derivative tokens, and participate in governance-driven capital allocation.
topography.relationship_narrative: Bracket Escrow Staking mints derivative tokens that can be used within Bracket Vaults for additional yield strategies. The BrktETH liquid staking token may serve as a deposit asset in vaults, creating a unified ecosystem where staked assets flow between escrow, LST, and vault products.
